comparison.objective: Lower a bent tube so four legs enter fixture slots simultaneously, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level control and simultaneous multi-point insertion; candidate is single-interface eccentric capture with tilt and roll.
comparison.success_condition: All four tube legs must occupy their slots without fixture disturbance; candidate requires snap retention and withdrawal verification. Candidate force/geometry thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Different constraint structure and tested insertion strategy.
